request.query: Residence permit for an employed person

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: Apply for a residence permit with this application if you are coming to Finland to work for a Finnish employer or other employer operating in Finland
You can fill in the application online in Enter Finland
Show the passport when you visit a service point to prove your identity
The passport photo must be no more than 6 months old
Colour copies of the passport page containing personal data and of all passport pages that contain notes
Document showing that you are legally staying in the country where you submit the application
After you have submitted your application in Enter Finland, your employer must add your terms of employment and other required documents to your application using Enter Finland for Employers
You must have confirmed employment before you can apply for this permit
If you applied for your residence permit abroad, book an appointment to visit a Finnish mission (finlandabroad.fi

sources.title: suomi.fi
highlights: You will probably need a residence permit to work in Finland if you are not a citizen of an EU Member State, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: When you apply for a first residence permit, you must always visit a Finnish embassy or consulate abroad to prove your identity in person

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: To be allowed to move to Finland for longer than 90 days, you need a residence permit

sources.title: dvv.fi
highlights: A personal identity code is issued to a foreign citizen moving to Finland from abroad after they have been registered in the Population Information System at their own request or at the time they are granted a residence permit

sources.title: enb.fi
highlights: Checked against Migri on 14 October 2026: first permits for employed persons (TTOL) that ended in a positive decision took an average of 17 days in July 2026, specialists usually get a decision in about two weeks, and Fast Track for specialists, EU Blue Card holders and start-up entrepreneurs has a 14-day target
After the decision, producing and posting the residence permit card takes about two more weeks
The clock starts when you prove your identity, not when you submit, and the card takes about two more weeks after the decision
Migri also says it can start on an employed person's application before identity has been proved, and that an employer who submits the terms of employment without delay speeds the processing up

What actually helps is removing in advance the reasons that lengthen the time: applying when you already meet the requirements, applying online through Enter Finland, filling in every section of the form carefully and adding all the required attachments, and paying the processing fee in Enter Finland before you submit
If a piece of information or an attachment is missing, Migri asks you for the document and the processing waits for it to arrive
